name: Name

start.aiBody: Describe the world, point it at characters, notes or files. It plans the entries, you review them, then it writes each one.
start.importBody: A LettuceAI or SillyTavern lorebook file.

aboutHint: Read first. Say what to cover and what to leave out.
aboutPlaceholder: A kingdom after a civil war. Cover the royal family, the northern gate and the harbour districts.
librarySourceHint: Their description and definition are read as source material.
dropFiles: Drop files here, or choose files
filesHint: Text, Markdown or PDF. Up to 50 MB each, 200 MB together.
unsupportedFile: {{name}} isn’t a text, Markdown or PDF file
sourcesTooLarge: Sources must be under 200 MB together
sourceSize: {{value}} of material. Long files are cut to the part the model can read.
entriesTargetHint: The outline aims for this many. You can add or remove before anything is written.

modelErrors.configured_model_missing: The model set for lorebooks was removed. Pick another in Settings, Lorebooks.
modelErrors.configured_model_not_text: The selected lorebook model cannot write text. Pick another in Settings, Lorebooks.
modelErrors.no_text_model: Add a text model in Settings, then choose it for lorebooks.

sourcePickerBody: Read as source material for the outline and entries.
label: Label
labelHint: Shown in the outline where it was used
suggestedKeys: Suggested. The writer may refine them.
keywordPlaceholder: Type a keyword and press Enter
coverageHint: The writer reads this with your brief and sources
planEditorBody: Only the plan. The entry is written from it in the next step.
alwaysPromptBody: Skip keywords; it’s part of every reply
keysHint: Any of these in the conversation brings the entry in
refineBody: Say what’s wrong. It rewrites this entry and keeps the old text in its history.
outlineHint_one: {{count}} entry planned. Change, remove or add any before it’s written.
outlineHint_other: {{count}} entries planned. Change, remove or add any before they’re written.
outlineApproved_one: {{count}} entry planned. This outline has already been approved.
outlineApproved_other: {{count}} entries planned. This outline has already been approved.
whileWriting: Read and fix the finished ones while the rest are written. You can leave; it keeps going.
reviewHint: Marking is for you. Saving keeps every entry with a title or text.
draftWaiting: Waits for the ones before it
checkingBody: Reading the entries together for clashes, repeats and loose names…
coherenceHint: Pick the ones to apply. Conflicts are only pointed out; fix those with Edit.
readyToSave_one: {{count}} entry will be saved. {{omitted}} empty entries are left out.
readyToSave_other: {{count}} entries will be saved. {{omitted}} empty entries are left out.
titleOnlySave_one: {{count}} entry has a title but no content. It will still be saved.
titleOnlySave_other: {{count}} entries have titles but no content. They will still be saved.
saveExistingBody: The entries go after the ones already there.
savedEntryHint: Saved entries are on and match keywords as written. Change that per entry in the lorebook afterwards.
canLeave: You can leave this page. It keeps going, and the draft waits in your library.
planningFailedBody: The outline could not be completed. Try again, or change the brief.
changeBriefBody: The old project will be discarded. Its brief and sources are copied to a new draft.

jobErrors.unknown: The operation could not finish. You can retry.
jobErrors.cancelled: Stopped before it finished. You can retry.
jobErrors.invalid_input: The model’s reply could not be read as the expected result.
jobErrors.capability_unavailable: The selected model cannot complete this operation.
jobErrors.integrity_failure: The result could not be verified.
jobErrors.resource_unavailable: The model or a required resource is unavailable.
jobErrors.lease_lost: The operation was interrupted. You can retry.
jobErrors.worker_failed: The model request could not be completed.
jobErrors.storage_failure: The result could not be saved.

discardBody: The outline and every entry written so far are thrown away. This can’t be undone.

settings.title: Lorebooks
settings.meta: Keyword matching and the lorebook writers
settings.messagesBody_one: An entry turns on when one of its keywords is in the last {{count}} message
settings.messagesBody_other: An entry turns on when one of its keywords is in the last {{count}} messages
settings.matchingHint: Lower keeps entries tied to what’s happening now. Higher keeps them around longer but uses more of the context. Applies to one-on-one and group chats.
settings.writerBody: Builds a whole lorebook from a short brief and the characters or chats you point it at. It plans an outline first, then writes each entry.
settings.entryBody: Writes a single entry for an existing lorebook, with its keywords, from a chat or a character.
settings.targetDefault: {{count}} by default. You can change it for each lorebook.
settings.replyLimitHint: Raise the reply limit if entries come back cut off.
settings.formatGroup: When the model can’t use tools

formatBodies.xml: For models that write XML more reliably than JSON.

settings.formatHint: Tool calls are tried first. This format is only used when the model doesn’t support them.
settings.promptsHint: Make your own in System prompts.

promptBodies.planner: Outlines the entries from your brief and sources
promptBodies.writer: Drafts each entry from the outline
promptBodies.refine: Rewrites an entry from your feedback
promptBodies.coherence: Suggests small fixes so the entries agree
promptBodies.keyword: Picks the words that trigger the entry

settings.automaticHint: Uses the first available text model
